title: Punctuation - The Comma (Theme 9: Wild animals)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 3 English; not yet checked by a Kenyan English teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child writes a comma after each item except the last two, which take and.

floor.prerequisite: Ends sentences with a full stop.
floor.question: Fix: I ate

steps: Read with a pause at each comma.
contexts: animals seen at the game park

board.do: Write: We saw lions zebras giraffes and elephants.
Point at the part to look at.
Wait for the child to answer.
The child writes or fixes it.
Show the right version beside it.

listen_for: We saw lions zebras giraffes and elephants.
drums and flags and balloons and sweets
I bought rice. beans. and sugar.

checks.question: Punctuate: I like mangoes oranges and bananas.
checks.answer: I like mangoes, oranges and bananas.

checks.question: Write three things in your bag as a list.
